sentences.text: Çdo ditë Drita shkon në treg.
sentences.english: Every day Drita goes to the market.
At the market there are many people.
"How much does the bread cost today?"

sentences.text: Sam shkon në shtëpi me bukë dhe djathë.
sentences.english: Sam goes home with bread and cheese.
